interpretation: Two weak historically positive but later negative environmental predictive contrasts share a single destination time series; no independent replicates of biologically useful inverse learned cues or individual cognitive failure established.
source_gate: Only pairs with >=7 of original early years can be left-one-year-out cross-validated with >=6 training observations; 70/166 were not estimable.
caveats: Previous environmental outcomes had been opened before designing the sign-stability diagnostic.
Leave-one-year-out folds share six or seven years and are not independent experimental replications.
Signs of detrended correlations estimated from 6-8 annual records are especially unstable.
Source and target cells are range-proxy geography, not tracked migration routes.
The real cue available at the individual decision time is not observed.
Only a squared timing prediction proxy is measured, not ecological payoff, reproduction or survival.
scientific_decision: NO EVIDENCE SUFFICIENT TO PROMOTE LEARNED-EXPERIENCE REVERSAL AS AN ECOLOGICAL DISCOVERY
